item.title: Streamlining Nuclear Licensing: Faster Approvals Without Sacrificing Safety
item.description: Excessive regulation has driven nuclear costs and delays without improving safety. Reforming the NRC is essential to ensure America can build the power it needs. America faces an unprecedented electricity challenge. Data centers, artificial intelligence (AI), electrified transportation, and re-industrialization are driving explosive demand for reliable, 24/7 power. item.title: How Russian Air Doctrine Shaped the Su-57 “Felon” Fighter
item.description: The Su-57’s design is optimized for short-range combat at the expense of stealth, meaning it is most effective when over friendly airspace in a defensive role. The post How Russian Air Doctrine Shaped the Su-57 “Felon” Fighter appeared first on The National Interest.
